concepts.statement_en: Given synthetic service events, choose ITR, household profile, or target list and identify who maintains it.
Given a fictional household change, complete and update the locally approved profile.
Given fictional profiles, identify eligible entries for WRA and pregnancy/postpartum lists and hand them to the midwife.
Given fictional ages and services, update newborn, infant, child/adolescent and oral-health target lists.
Given fictional adults, update NCD and older-person lists and identify a reviewed follow-up service.
Given a fictional household WASH survey, complete the four-part local sanitation record and hand over a concern.
Given several synthetic forms, find missing/contradictory entries, correct from source, and prepare a confidential supervisor handover.
